title: Currawinya National Park
get_in:
{{mapframe|-28.790|144.549|zoom=11}}
Entry points to the park are on the Hungerford Road, at [[Hungerford (Queensland)|Hungerford]] in the south, and at [[Eulo]] in the north.  The road is unsealed.  There is no public transport available within the park, or near to the park.  Some maps, for example Google Maps, show an entrance frp, [[Thargomindah]] via the Old Thargomindah Road.  This road is closed at the park boundary, and to get to Thargomindah you must go (nearly) through Hungerford.
